description: This is a false-colour infrared satellite image from Spot 5 (2.5 m resolution, 1/2/3 band combination), depicting an area classified as semi-natural grassland with woody plants. The image, dated 2011-08-27 (according to similar context images from CNES 2011©, Distribution Airbus DS/Spot Image), shows a distinct, irregularly shaped parcel of land outlined by a bright green polygon. Within this outlined area, dense woody vegetation appears in vibrant red hues, indicating healthy chlorophyll activity in the infrared spectrum. These woody areas are intermingled with more muted reddish-brown tones characteristic of grasslands. Linear patterns, possibly terracing or agricultural traces, are visible within and around the main outlined area. A small, bright green diamond-shaped marker is located near the centre of the outlined polygon, potentially indicating a sampling or validation point. Surrounding areas show similar land cover patterns including what appears to be cultivated land in shades of purplish-brown. This imagery illustrates the characteristics of semi-natural grassland where the Canopy Cover Density (C.C.D.) of woody plants is typically ≥ 30%.
